2026-10-28.homeNewsDetails: Thompson (lower-body) skated on Tuesday morning but remains a game-time decision to start Tuesday.
2026-10-28.homeNewsFantasyDetails: The Capitals' starting goalie will not be confirmed until warmups at 7:00 PM ET. Thompson has quietly become one of the NHL's most consistent and reliable goalies over the past several seasons, coming off consecutive 31-win campaigns. Despite some struggles at the start of the 2026-27 season, allowing three or more goals in three of his last four (1-3-0) and posting a 3.58 GAA and .880 SV%, the Capitals are eagerly awaiting Thompson's return, as he has missed the past two games.

2026-10-28.homeNewsDetails: Jarry will start vs. Calgary on Wednesday.
2026-10-28.homeNewsFantasyDetails: With Devon Levi (undisclosed) still expected to miss some time, the Oilers will continue to lean on Jarry. The 31-year-old Jarry was serviceable in his most recent outing, stopping 25 of 28 shots (.893 SV%), but fell short in a 4-3 shootout loss to the Detroit Red Wings. He has an ugly 3.53 GAA and .868 SV% in five games this season (2-1-2). The Oilers enter Wednesday's contest as -180 home favourites against a Calgary Flames team on a four-game winning streak.
2026-10-28.awayNewsDetails: Cooley will start in Edmonton on Wednesday.
2026-10-28.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Cooley has been phenomenal lately, making Head Coach Ryan Huska's decision to turn to him for a fifth consecutive game easy. The 29-year-old California-born goalie saved 26 of 28 shots (.929 SV%) in his most recent outing, a 5-2 win over the Toronto Maple Leafs. He has an outstanding 1.50 GAA and .955 SV% in his last four games (4-0-0). The Flames enter Wednesday's contest as +162 road underdogs against an Edmonton Oilers team that has scored three or more goals in 11 of 12 games this season (8-2-2).

2026-10-28.homeNewsDetails: Blackwood will start vs. New Jersey on Wednesday.
2026-10-28.homeNewsFantasyDetails: The Avalanche have been treading water in recent games, losing six of their last 10 (4-5-1), with suspect goaltending at least partly to blame. That said, Blackwood has been far more reliable than Wedgewood recently and is coming off a 31-save performance (.912 SV%) in a 6-3 win over the Tampa Bay Lightning. The 29-year-old Blackwood has 2.53 GAA and .914 SV% in his last four games (3-1-0). Colorado enters Wednesday's contest as -136 home favourites against a red-hot New Jersey Devils team that has outscored opponents 16-6 in their last four games (4-0-0).
2026-10-28.awayNewsDetails: Allen will start Wednesday in Colorado.
2026-10-28.awayNewsFantasyDetails: With the recent acquisition of three-time Vezina winner Connor Hellebuyck, Allen will likely see a lighter workload for the Devils, but he will tend the twine on Wednesday in the tail end of a back-to-back. The 36-year-old Allen has been serviceable, albeit unspectacular this season, posting a 2.84 GAA and .886 SV% in seven games (5-2-0). He had a light workload in his most recent outing, saving 12 of 13 shots (.923 SV%) in a 3-1 win over the Los Angeles Kings. The Devils enter Wednesday's matchup as +124 road underdogs against a Colorado Avalanche team that has lost three of its last four games (1-3-0).

2026-10-28.homeNewsDetails: Grubauer is in the starter's crease at Seattle's morning skate.
2026-10-28.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Grubauer has never lived up to expectations since joining the Seattle Kraken in their inaugural 2021-22 season, but he is off to a strong start in 2026-27. The 34-year-old German goalie was excellent in his most recent outing, saving 33 of 36 shots (.917 SV%) in a 5-3 win over the Utah Mammoth. He has a 2.76 GAA and .907 SV% in seven appearances this season (6-1-1). Seattle enters Wednesday's contest as +120 home underdogs against a Toronto Maple Leafs team coming off a 5-2 loss to the Calgary Flames.
2026-10-28.awayNewsDetails: Bobrovsky will start in Seattle on Wednesday.
2026-10-28.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Despite a 5-2 loss to the Calgary Flames on Monday, in which he allowed three goals on 32 shots (.906 SV%), Bobrovsky will return to the crease on Wednesday. The 38-year-old Bobrovsky has had an inconsistent tenure with the Maple Leafs so far, losing six of nine games (3-4-2) and posting a pedestrian 3.09 GAA and .897 SV%. He is coming off a career-worst season with the Florida Panthers, posting a 3.07 GAA and .877 SV% in 52 games (27-23-1), totals eerily similar to his pace so far in 2026-27. The Maple Leafs enter Wednesday's contest as -129 road favourites against a 7-4-1 Seattle Kraken team.

2026-10-29.awayNewsDetails: Dobes will start in Dallas on Thursday.
2026-10-29.awayNewsFantasyDetails: After a breakout 2025-26 season that continued with an impressive postseason run, Dobes has struggled early in 2026-27. As a result, the Canadiens have often turned to Jacob Fowler, who has dazzled when called upon, posting an absurd 1.54 GAA and .942 SV% in seven games (6-1-0). That said, after Fowler's sensational 46-save shutout in Montreal's previous game, the team will turn to Dobes on Thursday. The 25-year-old Dobes has played only once in the past two weeks, in a 4-3 overtime loss to the San Jose Sharks, where he allowed four goals on 30 shots (.867 SV%).
